item.title: Reference
item.description:
These pages state what Layer5 Cloud does, exactly: which plan includes a capability, which role holds a permission, how to reach support, and how to call the REST API. Use them to check a fact. To learn how the pieces fit together, start with Concepts.

Page Use it to
Feature Availability by Plan Find out which plan includes a capability and which plan limits Cloud enforces.
Roles and Permissions Find out which default role holds a permission.
Security Reference Check which keys hold each security permission, how long sessions and tokens last, and which endpoints manage keys, keychains, tokens, and sessions.
Workspace and Environment Reference Check defaults, limits, scope, permissions by operation, and error responses for workspaces and environments.
Support Choose a support channel and see what each plan includes.
Cloud API Authenticate, set the organization, page through results, and handle errors.
REST API Reference Look up every endpoint, generated from the OpenAPI document.
Release Notes See what changed in each Layer5 Cloud release.
